free_tier.correction: true — Maxio documents free Developer Accounts limited to test sites

free_tier_limits.correction: Free Developer Accounts have test sites only. Accounts may have up to 10 test sites; each test site is limited to 500 products, customers, subscriptions, and coupons. Developer plans allow up to 10 users, and inactive developer accounts are subject to eventual deletion.

rate_limits.correction: Custom slot-based concurrency limiting permits at most 4 concurrent API requests per subdomain. Excess traffic may be queued or throttled and may receive HTTP 429; limits can vary by endpoint.

cors.correction: CORS is not enabled on the Advanced Billing server; direct browser API requests are unsupported.

notes: The API and documentation are operational. The principal errors are the claimed absence of a free tier, the unpublished-rate-limit claim, and unknown CORS status. Maxio's public pricing page lists paid Grow and Scale plans, while its current product documentation separately identifies free Developer Accounts restricted to test sites.
